page: Vultr voc-m-24c-192gb-4800s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server featuring an AMD EPYC x86_64 processor. The system is configured with 24 vCPUs mapped to 12 physical cores with multithreading enabled. It includes 192.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Storage is bundled as a 4800 GB local NVMe SSD. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 2.0 GHz and features a shared CPU allocation.

In benchmark evaluations, this server demonstrates strong CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core metrics placing in the top 25%. PassMark CPU and physics tests also rank in the top 25%. Large-block uncached memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read speeds of 488.87 GB/sec and write speeds of 225.61 GB/sec, both placing in the top 10% tier. Conversely, small-block cached memory read bandwidth and PassMark database operations perform within the average middle 50% range.

The shared CPU allocation presents a potential tradeoff for workloads requiring sustained, non-burstable CPU performance, though the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8 and large local NVMe storage offer high resource density. This configuration is suitable for memory-intensive applications, database hosting, and caching layers like Redis, where the server achieved 55.54 million operations per second in SET benchmarks.
